title: CA2 somatic EPSP frequency response under NMDA and GABA blockade
question: After fixing single-pulse input strength, does the exported direct-input CA2 point model reproduce measured EPSP5/EPSP1 at 30 and 50 Hz?
amplitude_origin: Figure 4 CA2 weak single EPSP 1.76 +/- 0.32 mV SEM; transfer to Figure 5 APV is an explicit unverified cross-figure assumption. +/- SEM scenarios are setup sensitivity, not animal variability or a known APV amplitude range.
fit_permissions: Analytic holding current from unchanged intrinsic model
peak_measurement: Each cell peak after pulse plus 1ms delay and before next pulse plus delay; last peak window ends 100ms after last pulse. Normalize all peaks to the same 100ms prestimulus baseline and to the first peak. Average per-cell ratios, not a ratio of population averages.
measurement_limit: Baseline convention inferred from normalized traces; authors' analysis code not available. Also report an incremental-from-pre-pulse convention as a diagnostic without changing primary scoring.
subthreshold_gate: No spikes in any target, mean baseline within 0.05 mV of -70, max per-cell baseline drift <0.01 mV across the last100ms.
agreement_rule: Model mean at both primary frequencies must lie inside conservative digitized source-mean compatibility intervals. Report each seed and pooled means. If a primary cell response is suprathreshold, that run is ineligible and cannot pass EPSP scoring.
robustness_rule: Report all three predeclared operating levels. Robust conditional mismatch requires a miss at a primary frequency at every weak setup level, with numerical gates passing.
claim_limit: A match is conditional compatibility with selected published CA2 drug-blocked mean responses, not replication of the full paper or independent biological validation. A mismatch establishes failure for this implementation and these setup scenarios, not impossibility for every possible preparation.
excluded_claims: extracellular field potentials or population spikes
controls: static release preserving first impulse and all receptor kinetics
generic linear temporal summation null obtained only from calibration-seed single-pulse voltage responses
null: Average per-cell calibration single-pulse voltage kernel at selected recruitment; superpose at rounded train times; same baseline/peak convention. No train fits.
null_tail: Calibration recordings provide 100ms post-pulse support. Kernel is zero beyond 100ms; truncation is reported as a null-model approximation.
